457: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveFailureCheck.add("RaiseUserMainStats1LoseThirdOfTotalHP",
458:   proc { |move, user, ai, battle|
459:     next true if user.hp <= [user.totalhp / 3, 1].max
460:     next Battle::AI::Handlers.move_will_fail?("RaiseUserAtkDef1", move, user, ai, battle)
461:   }
462: )
463: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectScore.add("RaiseUserMainStats1LoseThirdOfTotalHP",
464:   proc { |score, move, user, ai, battle|
465:     # Score for stat increase
466:     score = ai.get_score_for_target_stat_raise(score, user, move.move.statUp)
467:     next score if score == Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE
468:     # Score for losing HP
469:     if ai.trainer.has_skill_flag?("HPAware") && user.hp <= user.totalhp * 0.75
470:       score -= 45 * (user.totalhp - user.hp) / user.totalhp   # -0 to -30
471:     end
472:     next score
473:   }
474: )

479: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveFailureCheck.add("RaiseUserMainStats1TrapUserInBattle",
480:   proc { |move, user, ai, battle|
481:     next true if user.effects[PBEffects::NoRetreat]
482:     next Battle::AI::Handlers.move_will_fail?("RaiseUserAtkDef1", move, user, ai, battle)
483:   }
484: )
485: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectScore.add("RaiseUserMainStats1TrapUserInBattle",
486:   proc { |score, move, user, ai, battle|
487:     # Score for stat increase
488:     score = ai.get_score_for_target_stat_raise(score, user, move.move.statUp)
489:     # Score for user becoming trapped in battle
490:     if user.can_become_trapped? && battle.pbCanChooseNonActive?(user.index)
491:       # Not worth trapping if user will faint this round anyway
492:       eor_damage = user.rough_end_of_round_damage
493:       if eor_damage >= user.hp
494:         next (move.damagingMove?) ? score : Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE
495:       end
496:       # Score for user becoming trapped in battle
497:       if user.effects[PBEffects::PerishSong] > 0 ||
498:          user.effects[PBEffects::Attract] >= 0 ||
499:          eor_damage > 0
500:         score -= 15
501:       end
502:     end
503:     next score
504:   }
505: )

510: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectScore.add("StartRaiseUserAtk1WhenDamaged",
511:   proc { |score, move, user, ai, battle|

513:     # benefit from it
514:     if ai.trainer.has_skill_flag?("HPAware")
515:       next score if user.hp <= user.totalhp / 3
516:     end
517:     # Prefer if user benefits from a raised Attack stat
518:     score += 10 if ai.stat_raise_worthwhile?(user, :ATTACK)
519:     score += 7 if user.has_move_with_function?("PowerHigherWithUserPositiveStatStages")
520:     next score
521:   }

681: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveFailureAgainstTargetCheck.add("RaiseTargetRandomStat2",
682:   proc { |move, user, target, ai, battle|
683:     will_fail = true
684:     GameData::Stat.each_battle do |s|
685:       next if !target.battler.pbCanRaiseStatStage?(s.id, user.battler, move.move)
686:       will_fail = false
687:     end

689:   }

691: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectAgainstTargetScore.add("RaiseTargetRandomStat2",
692:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
693:     next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if !battle.moldBreaker && target.has_active_ability?(:CONTRARY)
694:     next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if target.rough_end_of_round_damage >= target.hp
695:     score -= 7 if target.index != user.index   # Less likely to use on ally
696:     score += 10 if target.has_active_ability?(:SIMPLE)
697:     # Prefer if target is at high HP, don't prefer if target is at low HP
698:     if ai.trainer.has_skill_flag?("HPAware")
699:       if target.hp >= target.totalhp * 0.7
700:         score += 10
701:       else
702:         score += (50 * ((target.hp.to_f / target.totalhp) - 0.6)).to_i   # +5 to -30
703:       end
704:     end
705:     # Prefer if target has Stored Power
706:     if target.has_move_with_function?("PowerHigherWithUserPositiveStatStages")
707:       score += 10
708:     end
709:     # Don't prefer if any foe has Punishment
710:     ai.each_foe_battler(target.side) do |b, i|
711:       next if !b.has_move_with_function?("PowerHigherWithTargetPositiveStatStages")
712:       score -= 8
713:     end
714:     next score
715:   }
716: )
